messages.subject: Marco | Industrial & Natural Resources Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Giusti,

I am sharing my profile for senior international leadership mandates across industrial, natural-resources and multinational operating environments where government relations, ESG, corporate affairs and stakeholder strategy are central to execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My broader 12+ year career also includes regulated financial services and commercial operations. This combination has built a strong base in institutional trust, regulatory strategy, stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership across complex business environments.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my global executive CV for confidential consideration.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
